lines.sentence: There’s no need to be so volatile, friends!
Stupid fake magick. Come on guys! Let’s go!
Thank you for this, my head feels much better now… Even if you don’t know.

A shame they no longer believe. Although, personally, I think watching you dance was definitely worth losing them. If this is your best, claiming your strength and followers will certainly be difficult, but not hard enough.
You and your children have lost! Learn from this.
